dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0410 handles monthly insurance claim (receipt) file creation for outpatient/self-pay billing.
evidence: COPY directives with .INC files (CPRCF040.INC, CPRCF041.INC, CPRECEDAT1.INC)
ASSIGN RECE40PARA style (GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL environment variable assignment)
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) processing system - monthly outpatient and self-pay receipt detail file creation and insurance information editing
purpose.summary: ORCR0410 is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It processes monthly insurance claim (receipt) files for outpatient and self-pay (自費) billing, creating and editing receipt detail files and insurance information. The program reads indexed receipt files (RECE40/RECE41), performs calculations for medical fees, consumption tax, and various insurance categories, and writes output including error files.

notable_features: REPLACING clause on COPY for record renaming (RECE41 -> RECE412)
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
OCCURS tables for daily count arrays and institution tables
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. The source is clearly production-grade JMA ORCA medical receipt software, a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing system. Truncated at 16000 chars out of 147697 bytes (3210 lines total), so only the header and data division are visible.
